name: mcp-git-hosting
description: GitHub and GitLab MCP servers: PRs, issues, CI logs, reviews.

github_token.title: GitHub personal access token
github_token.description: Fine-grained PAT from github.com/settings/tokens. Leave empty and disable 'github' in /mcp if you don't use GitHub.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab personal access token
gitlab_token.description: PAT with api scope from GitLab > Preferences > Access tokens. Leave empty if you don't use GitLab.
